title: Net Profit of 15.2 Billion Yuan in Half a Year! Ant Group Advances on Three AI Fronts, Launching an All-Out Battle Across Payments, Applications, and Robotics
excerpt: On November 19, Alibaba released its 2026 third-quarter earnings report, disclosing that it recorded RMB 5.023 billion in income from Ant Group in the first hal
content_html:
On November 19, Alibaba released its 2026 third-quarter earnings report, disclosing that it recorded RMB 5.023 billion in income from Ant Group in the first half of the year. Based on this, Ant Group's profit in the first half of 2026 is estimated at about RMB 15.2 billion, up about 17% year over year. Profit growth was mainly driven by a net increase in fair value gains, with part of the increase offset by continued investment in technology and new growth initiatives. CEO Han Xinyi reiterated that the company will maintain high-intensity AI investment and drive the penetration of technology into diverse scenarios.

Since the beginning of this year, Ant Group has accelerated its AI strategy across three main lines: building the foundation, creating applications, and laying out the future. At the technology foundation level, Alipay launched a full-stack AI payment system to provide underlying payment and settlement infrastructure for the agent business ecosystem; OceanBase upgraded and launched an integrated lakehouse AI data platform, completing its evolution from a distributed database to a data intelligence foundation for the AI era.

In terms of application deployment, the health management AI app "Ant Afu" has served more than 150 million cumulative users, ranking among the top products of its kind globally in user scale; Ant Digital Technologies launched its "Agent Super Factory" solution centered on the Agentar platform, helping enterprises achieve large-scale production and operation of agents.

In frontier exploration and globalization, Ant Group entered the embodied intelligence track through Ant Lingbo Technology, and its "embodied-native" general-purpose robot brain has been deployed in smart pharmacy, logistics, and industrial scenarios. At the same time, leveraging Ant International's foundation of covering more than 220 countries and regions and serving about 2 billion consumers, its AI capabilities are accelerating cross-regional reuse. Currently, as AI commercialization enters a deeper phase, institutions such as CITIC Securities have included AI business and technology assets in Ant's valuation framework, and its AI healthcare, AI-powered Alipay, and payment infrastructure are gradually establishing new growth curves.
